scope: All videos overlap training; accuracy is measured on the training set, not independent generalization.

data.deduplication: Exact SHA-256 duplicates counted once in primary metrics; all 42 files uploaded.

training.negative_supervision: All sampled windows in negative-labelled videos; original label provenance retained.
training.positive_supervision: Only annotated timestamps +/-1 s; other positive-video regions remain unlabeled.
training.selection: Training video errors, then missed/wrong typed events, then typed false positives; never independent validation.
training.checkpoint_metadata: Base checkpoint metadata/config retained; hard_negative_refit records this update.

validation.method: Fresh multipart upload and asynchronous API polling for every source file; response/JPEG schema validated.
validation.environment: Windows, Python 3.12, PyTorch 2.7.1+cu128, RTX 5070; local API
validation.platform_scope: This checkpoint has not been revalidated in WSL, Docker or public HTTPS.

fully_correct_videos.definition: Correct verdict AND all annotated events matched with correct type within +/-5sec AND no unmatched predictions.

event_metrics.matching: One-to-one monotone temporal matching: maximum cardinality, minimum total absolute timing error, then type agreement between equally good monotone solutions.
event_metrics.scope: End-to-end detected typed events; includes detector misses, wrong types, and unmatched alerts. Human-unverified truth types are explicitly excluded from typed scoring.

limitations: Original workbook has binary/time labels; typed comparison uses the reviewed workbook/manifest.
Most binary/time annotations retain weak original provenance; matches mean agreement with supplied labels.
There is no single event accuracy with meaningful true negatives; use event precision, recall and F1.
All 42 files were tested; exact duplicates counted once in primary metrics.
publication: No videos, frames, credentials, reviewer notes, job IDs or absolute local paths included.
